value.rationale: This sharp, universal nonextendability boundary addresses the precise 0<s<2 condition in Hou–Toh’s convergence theorem. It isolates instability in the multiplier update even with an exact strictly feasible positive starting plan, arbitrarily large fixed penalty, and Y already equal to an optimal plan, separating genuine primal mismatch from difficult optimization. A complete finite-dimensional closed form proves a positive 2-cycle and disjoint-support supercritical polarization.
